title: Relocating to Chicagoland? Find the Perfect New Community for You
summary: Take our Community Finder Quiz to find your perfect match and explore all your new home options.
body_markdown:
Posted by[Alyssa Harper](https://www.mihomes.com/blog/alyssa-harper) in[Chicago](https://www.mihomes.com/blog/chicago) ,[Local Guides and Resources](https://www.mihomes.com/blog/local-guides-and-resources)


)


Whether you're moving for a new job opportunity, ready to be closer to family, looking to live in a great public school district, or simply ready for a change of pace, the Chicagoland area in Illinois offers a wide variety of suburban locations that make it easy to put down roots.


The region's expansive network of expressways, Metra commuter rail lines, major employers, highly regarded school districts, and vibrant downtown districts have made Chicago's suburbs a destination for families, young professionals, and remote workers alike.


But with so many places to choose from, where should you start?


We've created a quick **Community Finder Quiz** to help match you with the M/I Homes community that best fits your lifestyle, priorities, and daily routine.


---


From golf course living and spacious single family homes to luxury low-maintenance townhomes near commuter routes, here are six communities worth exploring as you plan your move to Chicagoland.


### Looking for Country Club Living and a Spacious Single Family Home?


If your ideal neighborhood combines luxury, recreation, and natural surroundings, **[Hawthorn Woods Country Club](https://www.mihomes.com/new-homes/illinois/chicagoland/hawthorn-woods/hawthorn-woods-country-club)** may be exactly what you're looking for.


Located in Lake County northwest of Chicago, this established, master-planned community offers resort-inspired amenities and beautiful home designs within a private country club setting.


Homeowners enjoy access to a championship golf course, clubhouse, fitness facilities, pools, tennis courts, and year-round community events. The community is also served by highly regarded schools.


**Perfect for:** Buyers seeking an active lifestyle, upscale amenities, and a strong sense of community.


### Looking for Luxury Living, A Peaceful Surrounding, and a Convenient Commute?


For buyers who want an elevated, low-maintenance lifestyle without sacrificing space or location, **[Northwoods of Naperville](https://www.mihomes.com/new-homes/illinois/chicagoland/naperville/northwoods-of-naperville)** offers a unique opportunity in one of Chicagoland's most desirable areas.


This exclusive community features luxury rooftop townhomes tucked within a private, wooded setting, creating a peaceful retreat while keeping everyday conveniences close at hand. Located just 5 minutes from I-88, this community is perfectly positioned for commuters and professionals working along the I-88 and I-355 corridors. Plus, a[Metra station](https://www.metra.com/train-lines/stations/naperville) is 10 minutes from the community, offering direct express trains to the Loop in Chicago


Whether you're working from home, commuting to the office, or simply looking for a lock-and-leave lifestyle, Northwoods of Naperville blends sophistication, convenience, and natural beauty.


**Perfect for:** Professionals, move-up buyers, and anyone seeking luxury living with less maintenance.


### Hoping for More Space in a Family-Oriented Community?


For buyers looking to stretch out and enjoy a little more breathing room, Huntley has become one of the fastest-growing destinations in the far northwest suburbs. Our **[Fieldstone](https://www.mihomes.com/new-homes/illinois/chicagoland/huntley/fieldstone)** community offers thoughtfully designed new homes within a community that balances small-town character with everyday convenience.


Homeowners enjoy nearby parks, recreation options, local dining, and easy access to I-90 for commutes throughout the region. Huntley's growing retail offerings and welcoming atmosphere make it especially appealing for those relocating from more densely populated areas.


**Perfect for:** Buyers looking for larger homes, value, and a community-oriented environment.


### Looking to Live in a Sought-After Suburb in a Low-Maintenance, Convenient Setting?


Located in coveted Lincolnshire, **[The Townes at Barclay](https://www.mihomes.com/new-homes/illinois/chicagoland/lincolnshire/the-townes-at-barclay)** places homeowners near several major business corridors while offering a low-maintenance lifestyle. This collection of new townhomes is ideally situated near the I-294 corridor, providing convenient access to employers throughout Chicago's North Shore and northern suburbs. It also offers direct access to I-94 and Route 45 and is around a 25-minute drive from O'Hare International Airport.


Homeowners can enjoy nearby shopping, dining, golf courses, forest preserves, and recreational amenities. Lincolnshire combines a polished suburban feel with excellent schools and a strong business presence, making it a popular choice among relocating professionals.


**Perfect for:** Busy professionals and households seeking convenience, accessibility, and low-maintenance living.


### Want a Growing Community With Everyday Conveniences Nearby?


Plainfield, IL has become one of Chicagoland's most desirable southwest suburban destinations, offering a balance of affordability, amenities, and accessibility—which is why **[Riverstone](https://www.mihomes.com/new-homes/illinois/chicagoland/plainfield/riverstone)** could be a great fit for you.


At Riverstone, homeowners can enjoy thoughtfully designed new homes close to shopping, dining, parks, schools, and commuter routes. The area's continued growth has introduced an expanding selection of restaurants, retail destinations, and recreational opportunities while maintaining its welcoming community feel. Its proximity to I-55 and other major roadways helps simplify travel throughout the region.


**Perfect for:** Buyers seeking a well-rounded location with strong growth and everyday conveniences.


### Looking for a Luxury Single Family Home in an Exclusive and Central Location?


Downers Grove, IL has long been one of Chicagoland's most desirable places to call home, known for its charming downtown, highly rated schools, and convenient access to everything the western suburbs have to offer. **[Talon Preserve](https://www.mihomes.com/new-homes/illinois/chicagoland/downers-grove/talon-preserve)** presents a rare opportunity to own a luxury new construction home in this sought-after location.


You'll live in an exclusive enclave of just 35 homesites features spacious single family home designs within the Downers Grove North High School boundary, offering an exceptional combination of prestige, privacy, and everyday convenience. You'll also live near the Main Street Metra Station, major employment corridors, local parks, shopping, dining, and entertainment while coming home to a community designed for elevated living.


Commuters will appreciate easy access to I-88, I-355, Route 83, and Route 56, making trips to the Loop or across the suburbs a breeze.


**Perfect for:** Buyers seeking a luxury single family home in a prestigious suburb with top-rated schools, established amenities, and a highly desirable location.


## Which Chicagoland Community is Right for You?


Every relocation and home buying journey looks different.


You may be prioritizing highly ranked schools. Or maybe you're hoping to have a shorter commute, access to outdoor recreation, a vibrant downtown district, or a low-maintenance lifestyle. The good news is that Chicagoland offers all of those opportunities.


Take our **[Community Finder Quiz](https://quiz.mihomes.com/chicagoland-community-finder/)** to discover which M/I Homes community aligns best with your lifestyle, then explore available homes, floorplans, and Quick Move-In opportunities throughout the Chicago suburbs.
